newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil ends up on China talk, new lows set.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil ends up on China talk, new lows set.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures closed higher, led by commercial buying in the nearby months, with talk China may have purchased 15,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil also boosting prices, traders said.

Cargill Inc keyed a cash-led advance with purchases in the December estimated at 800 lots, 200 lots each in the January and March and 100 lots of May, traders said. ADM Investor Services bought 400 lots of December and Continental Grain also was a noted purchaser of the January and December, they said.
The gains in soyoil came after new lots were set early.
The new low for January is 22.71 cents per lb, below the previous low of 22.85 set Thursday. Also new lows were set in soymeal amid spreading of soyoil/soymeal.
The new low for January soymeal is $211.30 per ton, down from the previous low of $214.50 set Thursday.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated by CBOT at 20,000 contracts, down from 20,677 Thursday. Soymeal volume was at 25,000, down from 33,220 Thursday.
Soyoil closed 0.14 cent per lb higher to 0.02 lower, with December up 0.14 at 22.73 cents. Soymeal was $0.50 to $3.30 per ton lower, with December down $3.30 at $216.20.
